column1: # --boost tiered-cutoff scan. Everything else at compiled defaults (dynmul=10
# is the compiled default, but --boost>=2 with a finite --cutoff silently
# takes over the per-probe budget and disables dynmul -- see yals.c
# yals_outer_loop, which now warns about this at --verbose>=1). Each row
# pairs a boost multiplier N with a base --cutoff so tier ceilings land in a
# comparable range across rows (N^k * cutoff): tier0=cutoff, tier1=N*cutoff,
# etc. A probe extends past a tier iff its best-falsified count is strictly
# below the running average of probes that reached that tier; otherwise it
# restarts. See yals_print_combined_boost_stats for the per-tier histogram.
